characters.description: Captain of Omega and leader of its human refugees. He directs raids on Ornu prison mines, balancing the rescue of enslaved people against danger to the ship and the civilians already aboard.
characters.name: Bill Henderson

characters.description: A senior officer aboard Omega who monitors the heat and structural risks created by repeated short-range jumps. Her calculations and operational advice are central to the prison-mine campaign.
characters.name: Bina Chakravarti

characters.description: The Marine commander responsible for extracting prisoners from the asteroid mine. He leads Omega's ground force into hostile facilities while the ship fights outside.
characters.name: Alden Stone

characters.description: An ancient, sentient warship that shelters humanity's refugees and carries out their rescue campaign. Its short-range jump system offers a major tactical advantage but risks severe damage when used repeatedly.
characters.name: Omega

characters.description: Omega's envoy and adviser within a simulated environment. Val calculates the danger posed by the ship's jump drive and helps Bill understand Omega's limits.
characters.name: Val

characters.description: A lieutenant returning to Omega's bridge after an illness contracted in an Ornu prison camp. He served with Bill before the rebellion and resumes duty while still recovering.
characters.name: James Riding

characters.description: Bill's father, identified as a long-term prisoner in an Ornu camp. His captivity links the liberation campaign directly to Bill's family.
characters.name: Gordon Henderson

characters.description: The pilot of the Marines' extraction can during the mine assault. Splat keeps the craft ready while Stone's team searches for surviving prisoners.
characters.name: Splat

characters.description: The Ornu ruler who holds Pertinax responsible for failing to destroy Omega. He accepts Pertinax's proposal to blame Philo for the widening crisis and orders the consul's execution.
characters.name: Ornu emperor

characters.description: An Ornu imperator whose standing is endangered after failing to destroy Omega. He survives the emperor's scrutiny by presenting his retreat as an act of loyalty.
characters.name: Pertinax

characters.description: An Ornu consul whom Pertinax proposes as a public scapegoat for the widening political crisis. His family connection to an escaped former Signifier makes him useful to the emperor.
characters.name: Philo

characters.description: An escaped former Ornu official connected to Philo. His disappearance from palace custody after a laboratory killing suggests that he received help from inside the capital.
characters.name: Former Signifier

characters.description: Bill's mother and Gordon's wife. She helps receive the traumatized survivors of a failed mine rescue and supports continuing the effort to free people still held by the Ornu.
characters.name: Miriam Henderson

characters.description: The British prime minister speaks for civilians demanding a secure settlement and opposes Bill’s decision to keep risking Omega on further liberation raids.
characters.name: British prime minister

characters.description: A four-armed Konami accomplice who helped the former Signifier escape and accompanies him in disguise to Philo's execution. He shares an immediate interest in overthrowing the Ornu emperor.
characters.name: Konami accomplice

characters.description: A Marine sergeant in Alden Stone's boarding party. Funnybone joins the assault on an enemy artillery freighter and advances with the team toward its bridge.
characters.name: Funnybone

characters.description: A Marine in Alden Stone's boarding party. Termite joins the assault on an enemy artillery freighter and advances with the team toward its bridge.
characters.name: Termite

characters.description: A Roughback military leader whose ships arrive during Omega's battle at the desert mining world. His intervention confirms that Omega still has a powerful ally.
characters.name: Tull

characters.description: The new ruler of the Ornu after his father's assassination. Val considers him more dangerous and vengeful than his predecessor, making Omega and the human rebellion an immediate target.
characters.name: Young Ornu emperor

characters.description: A civilian representative of the Roughback survivors on Kotbulo. The elder recognizes Omega as a living entity in need of support and considers Bill's offer of a neighboring world.
characters.name: Roughback elder

characters.description: A Marine assigned to physical security while Bill and Bina enter the Occidental simulation. Guns remains outside with Funnybone beside their immobilized bodies.
characters.name: Guns

characters.description: The British prime minister whose movement demands that Omega stop taking further risks and carry its residents to a planet.
characters.name: Rose

characters.description: The leader of a delegation whose people are breaking with the Perseids and Ornu. The spokesperson offers Omega transport, repair platforms, intelligence, and logistical disruption rather than combat forces.
characters.name: Breakaway species spokesperson

characters.description: The Konami figure who helped the former Signifier escape. He commands a restored ancient facility and uses Voidlings while questioning his captive ally about Omega.
characters.name: Konami leader

characters.description: A senior bridge officer aboard Omega. Facing the occupied destination, Hans admits that he needs evidence the promised free life is real, yet chooses to continue with Bill.
characters.name: Hans Norder

characters.description: Commander of scouts from hidden human settlements founded by people who escaped the Langer 3 mining colony. Tim makes cautious first contact with Omega on behalf of the independent fleet.
characters.name: Tim Bowman

characters.description: Bill's grandfather and leader of the Langer 3 breakout. The hidden colonists identify him as the rebel whose actions allowed their ancestors to escape and build a free community.
characters.name: Corey Henderson

characters.description: Leader of the independent human colonies and their fleet. The commander explains how the settlements survived inside asteroids with limited ships, patched equipment, farming, and strict concealment from the Imperium.
characters.name: Colony commander

characters.description: A freeborn young woman from the hidden human colonies. She assists Miriam and Gordon during their visit and helps introduce them to the community created by Corey's rebellion.
characters.name: Young colony volunteer

characters.description: A Marine in Funnybone's lunar assault group. Tubes survives the destruction of the team's transport and the deliberate crash into the Voidling tunnel network.
characters.name: Tubes

characters.description: The identity of the Marine sergeant known as Funnybone. Sean Piker is killed by a Voidling tank's shockwave while leading the depleted lunar tunnel force.
characters.name: Sean Piker

characters.description: One of the entities associated with Omega. Val names Tobias as part of the group asking Bill for complete trust while an enemy boarding force moves through the ship.
characters.name: Tobias

characters.description: One of the entities associated with Omega. Val includes Judith among those asking Bill to trust them to defend him and the ship during the internal assault.
characters.name: Judith
